pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/contest/node.rs:559 The only test that drives the real contest.mjs hand-restates the init argv instead of sharing create()'s construction and omits the --vault-subdir that create.rs:161 sends, so the contract it reports is for an invocation production never makes.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/contest/node.rs:559 Rule 1 says share the construction function. create.rs builds argv inline behind an AppHandle, so the test restates it and has already drifted: no --vault-subdir (create.rs:161, read at contest.mjs:158) and no --data. The id_args closure at node.rs:588 likewise restates Ctx::id_args. Nothing limits the claim to what the test kept.

pairs.registryProposal: a-test-helper-is-a-fork-of-the-driver names four axes (loaded, injected, identity, mode). A contract test that restates the argv of a command it cannot call is a fifth, 'what is passed'. It arises when the shipped builder sits behind an app handle, and the remedy is lifting the argv builder into a pure function.
